mentions.name: play.sharats.me reading games
mentions.description: A collection of reading games on play.sharats.me — including word safari, word family, and tiny farm — built to help a young child learn to read, progressing from reading letters to reading whole words and getting visibly faster.
mentions.problem: Helping a young child learn to read, moving from reading individual letters to reading whole words.
mentions.audience: The author's 5-year-old child who is learning to read
mentions.source_excerpt: Adding games to https://play.sharats.me for my 5yo to help learn to read. There’s word safari, word family, tiny farm etc.
mentions.author: sharat87
